standard_prerequisites: the obstruction class o(psi_n) in Ext^1_B(NL^wedge_{B/A}, a^nC/a^{2n}C) attached to a map psi_n : B -> C/a^nC, from the same chapter
multiplication by a^c on a^nC/a^{2n}C identifies with the projection to a^{n-c}C/a^{2n-c}C when a is a nonzerodivisor on C
the conversion of vanishing obstruction classes into lifted maps of Remark improve-homomorphism of the same chapter
I-adic completeness of C and limits of compatible algebra maps
core_obligations: Prove that for I = (a) principal, B with Ext^1_B(NL^wedge_{B/A}, N) annihilated by a^c for all B-modules N, C an I-adically complete A-algebra on which a is a nonzerodivisor, n > 2c, every A-algebra map psi_n : B -> C/a^nC lifts to varphi : B -> C agreeing modulo a^{n-c}C
proof_roadmap: The obstruction class o(psi_n) lives in Ext^1 with coefficients a^nC/a^{2n}C; since a is a nonzerodivisor on C, multiplication by a^c on these coefficients identifies with the projection a^nC/a^{2n}C -> a^{n-c}C/a^{2n-c}C, and the annihilation hypothesis forces o(psi_n) to map to zero there, a fortiori modulo a^{2n-2c}.
The obstruction remark converts the vanishing into a map psi_{2n-2c} : B -> C/a^{2n-2c}C agreeing with psi_n modulo a^{n-c}C, with 2n-2c > n because n > 2c.

Iterating yields a strictly increasing sequence n_0 < n_1 < ... with compatible maps psi^i agreeing modulo the required powers; completeness of C gives varphi as the limit of the psi^i mod a^{n_i - c}C.
difficulty_reason: H3: an obstruction-theory iteration specialized to the principal ideal case, where the nonzerodivisor hypothesis gives the key identification of coefficients.
